description: Upload a batch of events via the Amplitude HTTP V2 event-upload API.

events.description: List of event objects to ingest. Each may include insert_id, user_id, device_id, event_type, time, and event_properties.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has code, events_ingested (count), and server_upload_time.

description: Return event segmentation chart data (series counts by event type over dates).

event.description: Optional event_type to filter the segmentation series by.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has series, seriesLabels, and xValues.

description: Return a user's profile data and their chronological event stream.

user.description: The user_id whose activity to retrieve.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has userData and events; on failure (user not found), output contains an error message.
